value.rationale: The natural weakening of fixed-total conditioning to a modulo-three constraint qualitatively changes pair dependence: neither globally negative nor positive, but infinitely recurrent signs at every bias; a sharp six-class finite sign law at fair bias and arcsine empirical normalization at generic bias quantify the phenomenon. This is a motivated structural classification of weight-constrained Bernoulli sampling, not a bare elementary moment rewrite.
